title: Family Group Chat: can you wear the same chaniya choli twice?
concept: Chat v2 (30.5 s, 7 character beats + narrator ask). Hook in beat one: Mummy announces she is repeating her chaniya choli and 'nobody will notice'; Fai replies there are 400 Navratri photos in the group; Ba's 30-year brocade saree, Pappa's 2015 suit and Mummy's burn; payoff: Ba offers her 1994 dupatta. Aim: tags of the family outfit-repeater, shares to the family group.
